verdict.rationale: The public API is explicitly versioned under a /v1 base URL, with /v2 surfaces appearing. The docs give forward-compatibility guidance, and the OpenAPI YAML marks two request fields as deprecated. However, the docs state they carry no changelog or deprecation-policy text, so the policy half of the story is unmet. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (timelines, notice periods, sunset process), a changelog, and independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: a single versioned base ("All endpoints are relative to: https://api.earthclassmail.com/v1")
forward-compat guidance only ("Responses may include additional fields; clients should ignore fields they don't recognize.")
the YAML flags two request fields deprecated
